rationale.consistency: Perfectly matches existing codebase conventions, style, and uses standard Caddy HTTP helpers.
rationale.edge_cases: Fails on UTF-8 characters (EqualFold matches any invalid UTF-8 bytes) and mishandles stacked escapes or literal percent signs.
rationale.scope: Strictly implements the required suffix stripping logic without any extraneous changes or dead code.
rationale.readability: The code is well-structured and thoroughly commented, making the flawed reverse-iteration logic easy to follow.
rationale.robustness: Safe from out-of-bounds panics, though it silently aborts matching on unescape errors rather than falling back.
rationale.maintainability: Backwards byte-by-byte iteration over variable-length encodings is fundamentally fragile and hard to fix without a complete rewrite.
